lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation of approximately 5-6 vertical columns posterior to the gills, exhibiting increasing inter-blob spacing towards the posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct nodes in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the central ridge displays a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized region of labyrinthine, non-circular white patterning is present immediately posterior to the gill slits, where individual blobs appear to merge into irregular, elongated shapes.
